havrebakke-ppa-v2-execution.title: Power Purchase Agreement — Havrebakke Wind Farm

1_parties_and_buyer_credit.value: Seller: Havrebakke Vind ApS. Buyer: Jutland Board & Packaging A/S, unrated, obligations guaranteed by Jutland Industri Holding A/S under a parent company guarantee (Annex 4).
1_parties_and_buyer_credit.quote: The Buyer's payment obligations under this Agreement are guaranteed by Jutland Industri Holding A/S under the Parent Company Guarantee set out in Annex 4.

2_facility.value: Eight onshore wind turbine generators, 48.0 MW installed capacity, Havrebakke, Ringkøbing-Skjern Municipality, Denmark, bidding zone DK1.
2_facility.quote: eight onshore wind turbine generators with a total installed capacity of 48.0 MW located at Havrebakke in Ringkøbing-Skjern Municipality, Denmark, in bidding zone DK1

3_supply_period.value: 12 years from the Commercial Operation Date.
3_supply_period.quote: Supply Period: twelve (12) years commencing on the Commercial Operation Date.

4_cod_and_delay.value: Target COD 1 October 2027; Longstop Date 31 March 2028; delay damages EUR 9,600 per day after the Target COD, capped at EUR 1,750,000.
4_cod_and_delay.quote: If the Commercial Operation Date has not occurred by the Target Commercial Operation Date of 1 October 2027, the Seller shall pay the Buyer liquidated damages of EUR 9,600 for each day of delay, up to an aggregate cap of EUR 1,750,000.

5_price_and_indexation.value: EUR 54.50 per MWh, set out in Annex 2 (Election Sheet), not in the body; 30% of the price indexed to the Danish consumer price index from 1 January 2029.
5_price_and_indexation.clause: Part II 7.1 refers to Annex 2; Annex 2
5_price_and_indexation.quote: The Contract Price is the price per MWh set out in Annex 2 (Election Sheet).
5_price_and_indexation.quote_3: Thirty per cent (30%) of the Contract Price shall be adjusted on 1 January of each Contract Year from 2029 by the percentage change in the Danish consumer price index over the preceding calendar year.

6_volume_and_performance.value: Pay-as-produced, 100% of Metered Output; Expected Annual Production 158,000 MWh (P50); Minimum Annual Production 118,500 MWh with a shortfall payment.
6_volume_and_performance.clause: Part I, Contract Quantity; Part II 4.1, 4.5
6_volume_and_performance.quote: The Buyer shall purchase one hundred per cent (100%) of the Metered Output of the Facility during the Supply Period.

7_product_and_certificates.value: Electricity plus all Guarantees of Origin for the Metered Output, transferred to the Buyer at no extra cost; no capacity product.
7_product_and_certificates.quote: All Guarantees of Origin issued in respect of the Metered Output shall be transferred to the Buyer at no additional cost.

8_curtailment.value: Buyer may instruct curtailment up to 150 hours per Contract Year, paid as Deemed Delivered Electricity at the Contract Price; curtailment ordered by the transmission system operator is not compensated by the Buyer.
8_curtailment.quote: The Buyer may instruct the Seller to reduce the output of the Facility for up to one hundred and fifty (150) hours per Contract Year, and the electricity that would otherwise have been generated during such hours shall be treated as Deemed Delivered Electricity and paid at the Contract Price.
8_curtailment.quote_2: Reductions of output instructed by the transmission system operator shall not give rise to any payment by the Buyer.

9_delivery_point_and_balancing.value: Physical delivery at the metering point on the 60 kV side of the Havrebakke substation; Buyer appoints the balance responsible party and bears imbalance costs.
9_delivery_point_and_balancing.clause: Part I, Delivery Point; Part II 4.2, 5.2
9_delivery_point_and_balancing.quote: Delivery Point: the metering point on the 60 kV side of the Havrebakke substation.
9_delivery_point_and_balancing.quote_2: The Buyer shall appoint the balance responsible party for the Facility and shall bear all imbalance costs from the Commercial Operation Date.

10_credit_support.value: Seller: bank guarantee of EUR 2,000,000 from Financial Close until 12 months after COD. Buyer: parent company guarantee plus a letter of credit equal to nine months of expected payments.
10_credit_support.quote: The Seller shall deliver a bank guarantee in the amount of EUR 2,000,000 within ten (10) Business Days after Financial Close, to remain in force until twelve (12) months after the Commercial Operation Date.
10_credit_support.quote_2: The Buyer shall deliver a letter of credit in an amount equal to nine (9) months of expected payments under this Agreement

11_default_and_termination.value: Events of default include non-payment within ten Business Days of notice, insolvency, and failure to reach COD by the Longstop Date. Termination Amount is the mark-to-market difference between the Contract Price and the forward reference price for the remaining Supply Period.
11_default_and_termination.quote: The Termination Amount shall be the present value of the difference between the Contract Price and the Reference Forward Price for the Expected Annual Production over the remainder of the Supply Period

12_change_in_law_and_force_majeure.value: Change in Law is a defined term; if it increases a Party's cost by more than EUR 250,000 per Contract Year the Parties renegotiate, and after 90 days without agreement the affected Party may terminate without a Termination Amount. Force majeure beyond 180 days gives either Party a termination right.
12_change_in_law_and_force_majeure.quote: If a Change in Law increases the cost to a Party of performing this Agreement by more than EUR 250,000 in any Contract Year, the Parties shall negotiate in good faith an adjustment to restore the economic balance of this Agreement
12_change_in_law_and_force_majeure.quote_2: If an event of Force Majeure continues for more than one hundred and eighty (180) consecutive days, either Party may terminate this Agreement

olivos-solar-ppa-execution.title: Power Purchase Agreement — Valdeolivos Solar Park

1_parties_and_buyer_credit.value: Seller: Olivos Solar Proyecto Dos S.L. Buyer: Meseta Energía Comercializadora S.A., an electricity trader; no parent guarantee; credit support by letter of credit only.
1_parties_and_buyer_credit.quote: The Buyer is a licensed electricity trader and no guarantee of the Buyer's obligations is provided by any affiliate of the Buyer.

2_facility.value: Solar PV, 90 MWp DC / 75 MW AC, Valdeolivos, Province of Badajoz, Spain.
2_facility.quote: a ground-mounted solar photovoltaic plant with an installed capacity of 90 MWp (direct current) and a grid export capacity of 75 MW (alternating current) located at Valdeolivos in the Province of Badajoz, Spain

3_supply_period.value: 12 years from the Commercial Operation Date.
3_supply_period.quote: Supply Period: twelve (12) years commencing on the Commercial Operation Date.

4_cod_and_delay.value: Target COD 30 June 2027; Longstop Date 31 December 2027; delay damages EUR 6,000 per day, capped at EUR 1,500,000.
4_cod_and_delay.quote: If the Commercial Operation Date has not occurred by the Target Commercial Operation Date of 30 June 2027, the Seller shall pay the Buyer liquidated damages of EUR 6,000 for each day of delay, up to an aggregate cap of EUR 1,500,000.

5_price_and_indexation.value: EUR 38.75 per MWh, fixed, no indexation; in hours with a negative day-ahead price no payment is due for electricity delivered.
5_price_and_indexation.quote: Contract Price: EUR 38.75 per MWh, fixed for the Supply Period without indexation.
5_price_and_indexation.quote_2: In any hour in which the day-ahead price for the Spanish bidding zone is negative, the Contract Price shall not apply and no payment shall be due for electricity delivered in that hour.

6_volume_and_performance.value: Pay-as-produced, 100% of Metered Output; Expected Annual Production 165,000 MWh (P50); guaranteed availability 97% per Contract Year with availability damages.
6_volume_and_performance.clause: Part I, Contract Quantity; Part II 4, 5.6
6_volume_and_performance.quote: The Buyer shall purchase one hundred per cent (100%) of the Metered Output of the Facility during the Supply Period.
6_volume_and_performance.quote_3: The Seller guarantees an availability of the Facility of ninety-seven per cent (97%) in each Contract Year.

7_product_and_certificates.value: Electricity plus all Guarantees of Origin, transferred to the Buyer at no extra cost.
7_product_and_certificates.quote: All Guarantees of Origin issued in respect of the Metered Output shall be transferred to the Buyer at no additional cost.

8_curtailment.note: Not addressed anywhere in the document.

9_delivery_point_and_balancing.value: Physical delivery at the 220 kV connection point at the Valdeolivos substation; the Buyer acts as market representative and bears imbalance costs.
9_delivery_point_and_balancing.clause: Part I, Delivery Point; Part II 4.2, 5.2
9_delivery_point_and_balancing.quote: Delivery Point: the 220 kV connection point at the Valdeolivos substation.
9_delivery_point_and_balancing.quote_2: The Buyer shall act as the market representative of the Facility and shall bear all imbalance costs from the Commercial Operation Date.

10_credit_support.value: Seller: performance bond EUR 1,200,000 until COD. Buyer: letter of credit equal to three months of expected payments.
10_credit_support.quote: The Seller shall deliver a performance bond in the amount of EUR 1,200,000 within ten (10) Business Days after the Signing Date, to remain in force until the Commercial Operation Date.
10_credit_support.quote_2: The Buyer shall deliver a letter of credit in an amount equal to three (3) months of expected payments under this Agreement

11_default_and_termination.value: Standard events of default; Termination Amount is the replacement value determined by an independent expert appointed jointly by the Parties.
11_default_and_termination.quote: The Termination Amount shall be the replacement value of this Agreement for the remainder of the Supply Period as determined by an independent expert appointed jointly by the Parties

12_change_in_law_and_force_majeure.value: Change in law is NOT a defined term; the allocation sits in section 17: new taxes or levies after the Signing Date are borne by the Seller unless they exceed 3% of annual contract revenue, in which case the Parties meet to agree an equitable adjustment. Force majeure beyond 180 days gives a termination right.
12_change_in_law_and_force_majeure.quote: Should any law, regulation or administrative decision enacted after the Signing Date impose a new tax, levy or charge on the generation or sale of electricity from the Facility, the Seller shall bear such cost unless it exceeds three per cent (3%) of the Seller's revenue under this Agreement in the relevant Contract Year, in which case the Parties shall meet to agree an equitable adjustment.
12_change_in_law_and_force_majeure.quote_2: If an event of Force Majeure continues for more than one hundred and eighty (180) consecutive days, either Party may terminate this Agreement
12_change_in_law_and_force_majeure.note: The capitalised defined term must not appear; the lower-case phrase 'change in law' may appear at most in the Taxes section heading context but preferably not at all.

lichtung-offshore-ppa-execution.title: Power Purchase Agreement — Lichtung Offshore Wind Farm
lichtung-offshore-ppa-execution.seller: Lichtung Offshore Wind GmbH & Co. KG

1_parties_and_buyer_credit.value: Seller: Lichtung Offshore Wind GmbH & Co. KG. Buyer: Rheintal Spezialchemie AG, investment-grade; rating trigger: if the Buyer's rating falls below BBB- (or equivalent) it must post a letter of credit.
1_parties_and_buyer_credit.quote: If the Buyer ceases to hold a long-term credit rating of at least BBB- or equivalent from a recognised rating agency, the Buyer shall within twenty (20) Business Days deliver a letter of credit

2_facility.value: Offshore wind farm, 300 MW, German North Sea, approximately 60 km north-west of Borkum, connected through the transmission system operator's offshore grid connection.
2_facility.quote: an offshore wind farm with an installed capacity of 300 MW located in the German North Sea approximately 60 km north-west of Borkum

3_supply_period.value: 15 years from the Start Date of 1 January 2029.
3_supply_period.quote: Supply Period: fifteen (15) years commencing on the Start Date of 1 January 2029.

4_cod_and_delay.value: Start Date fixed at 1 January 2029; if the Facility is not commissioned by 1 July 2029 the Buyer may terminate; the Seller pays delay compensation of EUR 40,000 per day from the Start Date until commissioning, capped at EUR 6,000,000.
4_cod_and_delay.quote: If the Facility has not been commissioned by 1 July 2029, the Buyer may terminate this Agreement by written notice without any Termination Amount being payable by either Party.
4_cod_and_delay.quote_2: the Seller shall pay the Buyer delay compensation of EUR 40,000 for each day from the Start Date until the Facility is commissioned, up to an aggregate cap of EUR 6,000,000

5_price_and_indexation.value: Strike Price EUR 72.00 per MWh, escalating by 2% on 1 January of each Contract Year from the second Contract Year; settled financially against the day-ahead price for the DE-LU bidding zone.
5_price_and_indexation.quote: Strike Price: EUR 72.00 per MWh, increased by two per cent (2%) on 1 January of each Contract Year from the second Contract Year onwards.
5_price_and_indexation.quote_2: Reference Price means the hourly day-ahead price for the DE-LU bidding zone

6_volume_and_performance.value: Baseload: Contract Quantity 1,000,000 MWh per Contract Year in equal hourly quantities, settled regardless of actual output.
6_volume_and_performance.clause: Part I, Contract Quantity; Part II 4.1
6_volume_and_performance.quote: Contract Quantity: 1,000,000 MWh per Contract Year, delivered as a baseload profile in equal hourly quantities.

7_product_and_certificates.value: Financial settlement of the Contract Quantity plus 1,000,000 Guarantees of Origin per Contract Year transferred to the Buyer.
7_product_and_certificates.quote: The Seller shall transfer to the Buyer Guarantees of Origin in a quantity equal to the Contract Quantity in each Contract Year.

8_curtailment.value: Curtailment risk sits with the Seller: the Seller's settlement obligation for the Contract Quantity is unaffected by any reduction of the Facility's output ordered by the transmission system operator, except where it constitutes Force Majeure.
8_curtailment.quote: The Seller's obligations in respect of the Contract Quantity shall not be reduced by any curtailment of the Facility's output instructed by the transmission system operator, save where such curtailment constitutes Force Majeure.

9_delivery_point_and_balancing.value: No physical delivery; financial settlement of the difference between the Strike Price and the Reference Price for each hour of the Contract Quantity; the Seller remains responsible for its own balancing.
9_delivery_point_and_balancing.quote: Settlement: financial. No physical delivery of electricity takes place under this Agreement.
9_delivery_point_and_balancing.quote_2: The Seller shall remain responsible for the balancing of the Facility and shall bear all imbalance costs.

10_credit_support.value: Seller: parent company guarantee of EUR 25,000,000 from Lichtung Energie Holding GmbH. Buyer: letter of credit only on rating trigger.
10_credit_support.quote: The Seller shall deliver a parent company guarantee from Lichtung Energie Holding GmbH in the amount of EUR 25,000,000 within ten (10) Business Days after the Signing Date

11_default_and_termination.note: Events of default are listed, but the Termination Amount is defined only by reference to Annex 5, which is listed as 'to be agreed prior to Financial Close' and is not attached. The amount cannot be read from the document.
11_default_and_termination.quote: The Termination Amount shall be calculated in accordance with Annex 5 (Termination Amount Methodology).
11_default_and_termination.quote_2: Annex 5 — Termination Amount Methodology [to be agreed prior to Financial Close]
forbidden_words: present value of the difference between the Strike Price

12_change_in_law_and_force_majeure.value: Change in Law and Change in Reference Price Source are defined terms; a Change in Law that makes the Product unavailable allows termination without Termination Amount; a change in the Reference Price Source is replaced by the Parties within 60 days or by an expert. Force majeure beyond 180 days gives a termination right.
12_change_in_law_and_force_majeure.quote: If a Change in Law results in the Product, or any material part of it, no longer existing or no longer being capable of being delivered, either Party may terminate this Agreement by written notice without any Termination Amount being payable.
12_change_in_law_and_force_majeure.quote_2: If an event of Force Majeure continues for more than one hundred and eighty (180) consecutive days, either Party may terminate this Agreement
